doc.title: Clark Terry interviewed by Joe Williams and Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, May 19, 1995

title: Basie's house on the Bahamas golf course
summary: They discuss how Basie came to buy a Bahamas house on a golf course, after Catherine's real estate junket.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: He never did play. Not one time. Freddie Green used to tell me about that.
And his house in the Bahamas was right on the golf course.
Right. Well you know where he got inspired to do that, don’t you?
When he went down there, when Catherine went down on a junket and she saw ...

No. He came to Vegas and came by my house, and he said “you son of a gun you did it, didn’t you?” ‘Cause my house overlooked the thirteenth green and the fourteenth tee and the fifteenth fairway going up that way and at the fourteenth was a water hole, but the fourteenth going across the water that way.
And the fifth was coming across the water that way. No I sold that place. I sold that and bought a bigger place.

Well I thought he got the idea, he came, Catherine came down on a real estate junket and I had bought a lot down there. So they were showing them around, right across from Stone Crab. So they were showing them around and they said, “this lot over here, you probably wouldn’t know him but it belongs to a jazz musician named Clark Terry.” Catherine said “who?” So the next week she went back down there and they were having a sale, and they were trying to put out all the undesirable characters. Findlay.

Yeah. So all the undesirables had congregated there. They were going to make that the dope center of the world, and they had this big fellow by the name of Skiboo, who was like an alloy, he could pick up this table with one hand and throw it through that window. And when they found out that this was about to happen, Findlay put all of them off the island. And they had to sell whatever they had, or allow some Bahamian to have 51% control. So this guy had just built this beautiful house down there, with gold door knobs and about eight bedrooms and so forth, with a small swimming pool right on the golf course. And that’s when the Captain saw this house and he said, “that’s it.” He bought it for a steal.
